Pulse for 7 October 2026

The stories from 7 October 2026 in the Pulse of the Sapaude app, in our own words. Terms you don’t know are explained in the glossary. Glossary

New model

ChatGPT answers visually now

GPT-6 is the new model family behind ChatGPT's main chat, and it can now answer with charts, buttons and small interactive tools instead of only text.

New model

Claude Haiku gets far cheaper

Claude Haiku 5.5 is the smallest and fastest model in Anthropic's current Claude lineup, built for quick everyday jobs like summaries and sorting, and it now costs far less to run.

New model

Free AI search on your phone

An embedding model is a kind of AI that turns text, images or sound into lists of numbers so software can find similar things, and Google's new EmbeddingGemma 2 does this for free on phones and laptops.

Everyday tool

Turn a prompt into a game

Playground is an experimental Google Labs website where you describe a game in plain words and AI builds it, and Google launched it on October 7, 2026 for adults in the US.

Everyday tool

Spot AI fakes yourself

SynthID is an invisible watermark that Google and its partners hide in AI-made images, videos and audio, and Google's free SynthID Detector website now lets anyone check a file for it.

Everyday tool

ChatGPT takes meeting notes

Meetings is a new plugin for the ChatGPT app on Mac that listens to a video call or an in-person meeting and turns it into notes, a summary and suggested next steps.

Everyday tool

ChatGPT text gets a watermark

A text watermark is an invisible pattern hidden in an AI model's word choices, and OpenAI says ChatGPT and Codex will add one to text for EU users in the coming weeks.
